summary: Broken nose after walking into a bus shelter in Copacabana
story: On the afternoon of August 10 I was walking along Avenida Atlantica in Copacabana and I walked into a bus shelter and broke my nose. I would prefer not to go into what I was looking at. It was a beach volleyball match. The shelter was where bus shelters usually are. A lifeguard walked me to a clinic, where they X-rayed my nose, set it and gave me painkillers. The bill and the notes are attached.

items.description: Clinic treatment for a broken nose

documents.name: Clinic invoice
documents.content: Clinica Sao Lucas Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, August 10, 2026. Patient Trevor Mallory. Emergency consultation: $220.00. X-ray, nasal bones: $160.00. Closed reduction of nasal fracture under local anesthetic: $430.00. Medication: $70.00. Total: $880.00. Paid by card.

documents.name: Medical record
documents.content: Clinica Sao Lucas Copacabana, August 10, 2026, 15:25. Patient Trevor Mallory, age 40. Walked into a fixed structure, a bus shelter, while walking on the promenade about 30 minutes ago. No loss of consciousness. No alcohol. Examination: swelling and deviation of the nasal bridge, nosebleed now stopped. X-ray: displaced fracture of the nasal bones. Treatment: closed reduction under local anesthetic, splint, pain relief. Fit to fly. Dr. M. Carvalho.
